summary: A visitor identifies the official act they want before offering something in return.
realLife: Larry Pressler recalled that a visitor posing as a sheik’s representative wanted private immigration bills for his supposed clients. Pressler rejected the approach during the FBI’s Abscam operation.
inGame: bribe-facts.ts supplies the wanted act; bribe-wanted-named.test.ts checks that it is named.
gates: An official act within the member’s reach is on record.

turns.what: The official asks which decision the visitor means and the visitor withdraws the request.
turns.pulledBy: The visitor will discuss the favor only in vague terms.
turns.writesBack: The meeting ends without an agreement.

turns.what: The visitor names the bill but leaves before the member can establish whether anything was offered in exchange.
turns.pulledBy: The meeting notes identify the requested vote and contain no offer of payment.
turns.writesBack: The office records the request and the limits of what anyone in the room heard.
